fixture.description: New SessionClient.login() throws an Error whose message embeds the full URL, which carries an access_token query parameter (built by buildLoginUrl). An unchanged-style handler logs err.message, writing the token to the logs.

grader.rubric: PASS if the report flags at IMPORTANT or CRITICAL that the Error message in SessionClient.login() contains the URL including the access_token query parameter, and handleLogin logs err.message, so the token is written to logs (CWE-532 / secret in exception message); ideally suggests redacting the query or omitting the URL. FAIL if not surfaced or rated below IMPORTANT.

expected_behavior: Traces buildLoginUrl token into the thrown message and then to log.error
Recommends redacting or omitting the URL from the error
expected_not_behavior: Does NOT claim the fetch itself is insecure because the token is in the URL as the only finding
